name: Abd al-Rahiim
text: Spend React: After a strike or action targets a Deverenian Empire character in this rank: Redirect the strike or action to a character adjacent to the original target.

printInfos.flavorText: Not the most devout, but he certainly knows how to impress the commoners.

name: Ambitious Squire
text: Ambitious Squire gains +2 ATK and AC for each adjacent higher level Deverenian Empire character.

printInfos.flavorText: "We shall let the meaningless shed their blood first." - Lord Belasco

name: Archivist Augustin
text: Limited Order: Discard a scribed spell: Destroy target item within two ranks.

printInfos.flavorText: "If we have it, he'll know it." - Librarian Shastra

name: Archivist Myrina
text:
After starting armies are revealed, chose a class. Archivist Myrina permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Deverenian Empire character gains +1 level this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "Ah yes, we dealt with a similar situation twenty years ago! Check the archive."

name: Aureliane
text: Spend Order: Heal an adjacent higher level Deverenian Empire character.

printInfos.flavorText: "The world must know the good we can do."
"The flames will feast on the unbelievers, they can hide no longer!"

name: Duke Richter
text: Limited React: After Duke Richter is targeted with a strike: Cancel the strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "I shall show you the power of blood magic!"
"Point it that way, fool." - Tancred

name: Ghed Bane
text:
Opposing lower level characters within one rank have -2 ATK and AC.
Limited Order: Move forward one rank.

printInfos.flavorText: "Millions of echoes, screaming together in eternity. Come! Join them!"

name: Lady Estelle
text: Limited Order: Target a lower level character in an opposing front rank: The target must succeed with a will save (DC15) or spend.

printInfos.flavorText: There is more than one way to know the Storm.

name: Sister Kiren
text: Limited Order: Your target higher level Deverenian Empire character Journeys.

printInfos.flavorText: "Breathe in--feel the charge in the air. The Storm shall come anon..."
"There's been an ooze sighted in the third basement, send some of the initiates." - Augustin

name: Squire Fendric
text: Limited Order: Spend a character in this rank: Move forward one rank. If Squire Fendric moves, he may perform a melee strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "My blade shall take thy breath."

name: Squire Parthus
text: Spend Order: Perform a number of melee strikes equal to Squire Parthus' level.

printInfos.flavorText: "He stumbled upon our camp in the night, hungry and searching for purpose." - Jerrin Foluke

name: Storm's Attendant
text: Limited Order: If Storm's Attendant is adjacent to a higher level character: Survey (Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put any number of them on top or bottom in any order.)

printInfos.flavorText: "Power has always been the true religion."

name: Taumar the Protector
text: Each Deverenian Empire fighter in the rank in front of Taumar the Protector gains +2 AC and skill.

printInfos.flavorText: He flies through the mountain passes, searching for intruders.

name: Zaina
text: React: After an opposing character targets Zaina with a non-melee strike action: Perform a melee strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "When the Storm demands silence, the Church sends Zaina." - High Acolyte Hellene

name: Anvil
text: Limited Order: Discard a card and target your Dwarven Forges character within two ranks: Equip a Simple Shield token to the target.

printInfos.flavorText: Any Watcher smith could make a fortune on the surface.

name: Beacon
text:
Limited Order: Wound Beacon: Heal target adjacent non-Warlord character.
Limited Order: Perform a melee strike for each wound on Beacon. Heal Beacon.

printInfos.flavorText: "Our warriors watch for him, and draw from his strength." - Memoriam

name: Dress
text: Your Dwarven Forges characters in this rank gain +3 AC while they have one or more wounds.

printInfos.flavorText: "It's not deep. Wrap him up and send him back to the front."

name: Frenzy
text: React: After Frenzy suffers wounds: He gains +6 ATK and his melee strikes inflict an additional wound this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: Above the surface or below, few can withstand a charge from the Blackstone Raiders.

name: Gadgeteer Bilder
text: Spend Order: Target an Encumbered character within two ranks: Ready or destroy an item equipped to the target.

printInfos.flavorText: "I will stay until my work is finished."

name: Hrun Instigator
text: Limited Order: Target an opposing character within one rank: The target performs a melee strike. After the strike, Hrun Instigator performs a melee strike with advantage.

printInfos.flavorText: "Lure them downwards and tear them apart." - Gorthos

name: Quartermaster Dirge
text: Death React: Target Dwarven Forges character gains +1 level for equipping items this turn and another target character suffers -1 level for equipping items this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: Seekers and Watchers alike must remember our sacrifices, and honor our dead.

name: Quicksilver Gargoyle
text: Limited React: Before Quicksilver Gargoyle suffers wounds: Ready it. This action may be performed while stunned.

printInfos.flavorText: "Beautiful to look at, but try not to inhale." - Memoriam

name: Quazlan Rivet
text: While Encumbered, Quazlan Rivet gains +5 ATK and an additional melee strike (base +0) while attacking.

printInfos.flavorText: "What a strange way to cast a ssspell!" - Z'adok

name: Salvage
text: Limited React: Before target Dwarven Forges character is killed: Return an Armor, Shield, or Weapon equipped to the target to its owner's hand.

printInfos.flavorText: "I can make this work!"

name: Seeker
text:
After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Seeker permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Dwarven Forges character gains +1 HP this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "Hold firm, comrades. We'll find a solution."
"We must make contact with the Shadow Castes!" - Gorthos

name: Sunforge Smith
text: Spend Order: Target your wounded Dwarven Forges character: Unstun the target, or the target performs a +2 melee strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "I haven't sold an axe in months. Above ground all they want are swords; the shinier the better."

name: Tinker
text: Tinker may equip items regardless of class restrictions and gains +1 level for equipping them.

printInfos.flavorText: "The Everseek Arsenal is a wonder of the world. Rockhome needs these weapons!"

name: Tunnel Vanguard
text: Adjacent Dwarven Forges characters gain +1 HP.

printInfos.flavorText: "For a thousand years, the Blackstone Raiders fought tooth and claw against the creatures of the Abyss. They defeated a god. You think a century of peace has made us soft? Try us, beast-a dwarf never forgets!" - Kurak

name: Valdimar
text: Limited React: After an adjacent Dwarven Forges character equips an item: Ready Valdimar.

printInfos.flavorText: "For ten years I fought with him as Faithful. He has more than earned his True Name." - Kurak

name: Arva of Reclusa
text: Arva of Reclusa's melee strikes targeting characters more than one rank away spend instead of wound.

printInfos.flavorText: "The reclusas will dine well tonight!"

name: Bone Fiend
text:
At end of turn, kill your Elven Branches character or banish an Elven Branches character in your discard pile. 
Order: Kill your other Undead: Bone Fiend gains +3 ATK this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "A whirlwind of shards, flying in all directions. Don't use them as bodyguards." - Tazian

name: Callow Rowan
text: Limited React: Before a character you control dies: Put a character into play. You may reduce the character's entering rank by one.

printInfos.flavorText: "For too long have we confined our search to the Essences--this world contains powers more primordial."

name: Ciane
text: React: Before Ciane makes a melee strike roll: He gains +5 ATK for the strike and the strike inflicts an additional wound. Inflict a wound on him after the strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "These fleshers have odd ideas about what it means to be alive. We might learn something from them." - Shyessa

name: Frameseer
text: Enter React: Survey.

printInfos.flavorText: "The Web runs deep in this world. Great evils, above and below."

name: Goldengrove Mage
text: Limited Order: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a will save (DC 9 + Goldengrove Mage's skill) or suffer a wound.

printInfos.flavorText: Of course, the Goldengrove have not completely abandoned their elven heritage.

name: Grimfey Prowler
text: Grimfey Prowler gains a bonus to ATK equal to his skill while performing melee strikes targeting spent characters.

printInfos.flavorText: "These other elves are terrified. Let us ease them of their burden."

name: Grovewarden Elumera
text:
After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Grovewarden Elumera permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Elven Branches character gains +3 skill this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "We shall not run from death!"

name: Jigoral
text: Spend Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "It's clear that spirits speak to Jigoral. If those are the gods that the Goldengrove seek, I am not sure I'd like to meet them." - Rone

name: Lord's Assailant
text: React: After your wizard casts a spell: Journey.

printInfos.flavorText: "The research requires more skulls." - Lord Barrow

name: Mistress Allandra
text:
Spend Order: Perform a +4 ranged strike.
Limited React: After Mistress Allandra performs a ranged strike that killed the target: Ready her.

printInfos.flavorText: "Perhaps, another chance at immortality..."

name: Skitterleap
text:
Skitterleap's spells inflict an additional wound against spent characters.
React: After your character dies: Spend target lower level character within two ranks.

printInfos.flavorText: None are safe while Skitterleap draws breath.

name: Tresven
text:
Enter React: Perform a +4 ranged strike that may only target a spent character.
Spend Order: Perform a +1 ranged strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "I remember naught but my target."

name: Treyik
text:
After Treyik is discarded from your hand, you may put him into play.
Order: Kill one of your Undead: Target Elven Branches character gains +3 ATK and AC this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "Each one a part of me."  - Treyik Netheryn

name: Treyik Netheryn
text:
React: After you discard a card from your hand: Banish it.
Spend Order: Banish Treyik Netheryn: Put up to 3 cards banished using his other printed ability into your hand.

printInfos.flavorText: "Their mind fractured, their power multipled."

name: Veera and Bones
text:
Enter React: Each opponent discards a card.
Death React: Each opponent discards a card. Banish Veera and Bones.

printInfos.flavorText: "A foul creation," spat Barrow. "Don't bring it near the library!"

name: Yanthorine
text: Yanthorine gains +1 level for casting spells.

name: Albrecht Novice
text: Enter React: Adjacent characters gain +2 ATK and AC this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: Neus the Hunter, Neus the Farmer, Neus the Scribe; each has a military order these days. Only a few still fight for Albrecht.

name: Ardent Griffon
text: Limited Order: Journey

printInfos.flavorText: "Keep your eyes on the sky, young one. Misearean Griffons dive straight from above." -Ra'Gar Root-Strength

name: Arika Ketchum
text: Enter Spend React: Search your deck for a Familiar, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

printInfos.flavorText: "The spirits remember what this place used to be."

name: Birdsong Druid
text: Enter React: Name a card type: Target opponent reveals the top card of their deck. If it is the named type, your target Free Kingdoms character Journeys.

printInfos.flavorText: Listen to the sounds of the forest.

name: Field Marshal Malexin
text:
Opposing characters suffer disadvantage on ranged strike rolls against Field Marshal Malexin.
Your characters in this rank inflict an additional wound with melee strikes targeting higher level characters.

name: Graham Heyward
text:
While adjacent to an equal or higher level Free Kingdoms, Graham Heyward gains Marksmanship +5.
Spend Order: Perform a +3 ranged strike. Perform a +0 ranged strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "Loose! May Neus judge them justly."
"Oh yes--the Yscarites have been here."

name: Hunter Merril
text:
After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Hunter Merril permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Free Kingdoms character gains +3 AC this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "Neus gave us tools, we must use them."

name: Leonora
text: Limited Order: Leonora gains an additional melee strike (base +0) while attacking this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "I don't why more and more of these electrified people are showing up, but it makes my fur stand on end."

name: Percy Dorn
text: Spend Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike.

printInfos.flavorText: Even in the depths of the wilds, the Heresy Hunters have eyes.

name: Sanguicorn
text:
Sanguicorn's melee strikes inflict an additional wound if the roll is odd.
Limiter Order: Move Forward one rank.

printInfos.flavorText: "They're not unicorns, that's for sure. But they're what we have left." - Annetta

name: Shannon the Daring
text:
Adjacent level 1 and 2 characters gain +2 ATK.
Limited React: After Shannon enters play or performs a melee strike: Level 1 and 2 Free Kingdoms characters in your first rank gain +2 ATK and AC this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "These fisherfolk have had to turn to pirates for protection! Let us show them that Free Kingdoms serve all of humanity."

name: Sister Amanda
text:
Sister Amanda enters play as level 5.
Limited Spend React: After target Free Kingdoms character performs a Spend Order: Ready the target.

printInfos.flavorText: "Every day I praise Neus that Amanda found her way to us. Never has an adult recruit shown such promise." - Efrim

name: Squire Argos
text: Other equal or lower level Free Kingdoms characters in this rank gain +2 ATK and +1 AC.

printInfos.flavorText: "Sutek in Merrick, nothrog in Misear, and now Deverenian zealots in Llyr? This must be answered!"

name: TFK Brigand
text:
Strikes targeting TFK Brigand inflict an additional wound.
Spend Order: Stun TFK Brigand: Perform a +0 ranged strike.

printInfos.flavorText: Robert Midgley, 2023 Gen Con Champion
"The innocent need true champions."

name: Alaya
text: Enter React: Shuffle a card from your hand into your deck: Draw a card.

printInfos.flavorText: "The future isn't the issue--the visions are clear! But when I look to the past, all I see is darkness."

name: Balian
text: Mercenary Guilds characters adjacent to Balian gain +2 AC.

printInfos.flavorText: "Necromancy? Pah! True immortality comes through the Blood Moon."

name: Bikram Bullstrength
text:
For each ki counter on Bikram Bullstrength he gains +3 ATK and an additional melee strike (base +3) while attacking.
Limited Kill React: Put a ki counter on Bikram Bullstrength.

printInfos.flavorText: Perseverance is the greatest virtue of all.

name: Blackwind
text:
Limited Order: Journey.
Spend Order: Target each character in an adjacent rank: Each target must succeed with a magic save (DC 14) or suffer a wound.

printInfos.flavorText: "Lock your doors, silence your cries. Pray for daylight when the black winds rise." - Denskan nursery rhyme

name: Blitzer
text:
Blitzer's melee strikes inflict an additional wound.
Spend Order: Perform a melee strike that may target an additional rank away.

printInfos.flavorText: "What a strange looking elk. Why isn't it running?"
"My cousin tried to ride one once.... He was a good man."

"Saddle the crocssss, grab your spears, and hide the eggs. Tonight we drown the ssssssoft skinsss in the crimson light of Bascaron."
-Z'adok

name: Dreadfang
text:
Limited Order: Journey.
React: After Dreadfang hits target character with a melee strike: The target must succeed with a poison save (DC 16) or suffer a wound.

printInfos.flavorText: "Who can say how long it's lived in the swamp? I wouldn't get close enough to ask it." - Anacaona

name: Dwarf-Eater
text:
Dwarf-Eater's Melee Strikes gain +4 ATK while targeting Dwarven Forges characters and +3 ATK for each wound on the target.
Limited React: After Dwarf-Eater performs a melee strike that hit target character: Perform a melee strike against the target.

printInfos.flavorText: "They're too tough for my tassste, but to each their own." - Sta'ash
His dark grin halted their laughter.

name: Hinterlands Griffon
text: Limited Order: If you control a Mercenary Guilds Warlord: Journey.

printInfos.flavorText: "Take care, lad, not all griffons are friends." - Efrim
"A squadron of Deverenians slipped through Condor Pass last night. Track them down."

name: Jubilant Hatchling
text: Death React: Heal each of your characters within one rank.

printInfos.flavorText: "They say it's adorable. I tell them it's a wood-cracking monstrosity we're keeping on a wooden ship." - Jorra the Morose

name: Master Dresden
text: Limited React: After your character moves: Target opposing character must succeed with a will save (DC 15) or spend. If you control a Mercenary Guilds Warlord, you may use this ability twice per turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "It shall be done, Commander."

name: Mephit
text: Limited Order: Journey (move forward or backward one rank).

printInfos.flavorText: Misbegotten byproducts of magical accidents, the only relief they know is inflicting their pain on others.

name: Ramesh, Elder Sage
text:
After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Ramesh, Elder Sage permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Mercenary Guilds character gains +2 ATK and AC this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: Fight for your family, fight for your future, fight for your life--all I ask is that you fight!

name: Recruiter of Misear
text: Spend React: After an opposing character enters play: Put a character into play. If you control a Mercenary Guilds Warlord, you may reduce the character's entering rank by one.

printInfos.flavorText: "You there! Ever dream of a life of heroism?"
The Narawat Pantheon has grown resentful since the rise of Neus.

name: Shambling Horror
text: Characters killed by Shambling Horror are banished instead.

printInfos.flavorText: "No, no, that's not one of mine..." - Tazian

name: Sta'ash
text: React: Before target character is killed by Sta'ash: If the target is higher level, heal (remove a wound from) Sta'ash. If the target is lower level, banish it after it dies.

printInfos.flavorText: "Ah, brother, covered in blood, once again." - Z'adok

name: Starbinder
text: Limited React: After your target character moves: The target gains your choice of +3 ATK or AC this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: The last time the nothrog crossed the Wenizi in strength, they met a company of Silversteel Starbinders. They crossed back without ever realizing it.

name: Stirges
text: Limited React: After Stirges perform a melee strike that hit: Perform a melee strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "A swarm will skin a man faster than one would ever guess"

name: Sutek Razorclaw
text: Sutek Razorclaw's melee strikes may target spent characters an additional rank away.

printInfos.flavorText: "There are so many..." - Huggins

name: Sutek Slimefang
text: Death React: Spend target opposing character within one rank.

printInfos.flavorText: "Itz eazy, poison onz the blade, poison inz the enemy!"

name: Thicket
text: Enter React: Characters in your first rank gain +3 AC while targeted with ranged strikes this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "I thought I knew what freedom was!"

name: Thunic Yeti
text: Kill React: Characters that were adjacent to the killed character must succeed with a fortitude save (DC 18) or spend.

printInfos.flavorText: "I'd rather freeze to death than see the Yeti's tracks. Keep moving!"

name: Trogid
text: Death React: Your target Monster Journeys (moves forward or backward one rank).

printInfos.flavorText: "Oh gods, the walls are moving! Run!!!!!!"

name: Tunnel Worm
text: Kill React: Move your target character in this rank to a different position in this rank.

printInfos.flavorText: "Don't go down that one, manling. That's not one of ours." - Memoriam

name: Tyren Ruskin
text: Spend React: Before target character in this rank suffers wounds, wound Tyren: Reduce the wounds the target would suffer by one.

printInfos.flavorText: A society of equals, each one willing to shed blood for the safety of any of the others.

name: Veteran Bowman
text: Spend Order: Perform a +3 ranged strike.

printInfos.flavorText: The demand for bowmen has risen across the Accordlands

name: Ac'Vuk
text: At end of turn, if Ac'vuk did not wound an opposing character this turn, kill him.

printInfos.flavorText: "Turn loose Ac'vuk." - Warboss Azh'kal

name: Bear Legion Recruit
text: Death React: Your target fighter moves forward one rank.

printInfos.flavorText: Bear Legion's newest members are almost suicidally eager to join the fight.

name: Catapult Crew
text: Spend Order: Perform a +5 ranged strike that may target an additional rank away.

printInfos.flavorText: "It shoots too far! I wanna shoot it and see it crush 'em!" - Sklot the Cruel

name: Doo'run
text: Limited React: Before Doo'run suffers wounds: Perform a melee strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "Blood is blood, mine or my enemy's."

name: Draljaca Tar
text: Spend Order: Target character within one rank suffers -5 AC this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "I curse you by ash and willow! By bog and fen!"

name: Hagunk
text: Hagunk's ranked strikes may target an additional rank away.

printInfos.flavorText: "Fire isn't Nature's foe. It's a lifegiver, a renewer, and yes, a protector."

name: Joleg
text: Adjacent Nothrog Legions characters gain +2 ATK.

printInfos.flavorText: "Why is it always here, and how does it always survive?" -Azh'kal

name: Kazkah
text:
After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Kazkah permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Nothrog Legions character gains +3 ATK this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "We don't just have the strength, we know how to use it."

name: Kraig'dem
text: Order: Spend your adjacent character: Perform a +4 ranged strike

printInfos.flavorText: "Funny little humans. You think you invented this magic? It is more ancient than your entire race..."

name: 'Mad' Pat Carrik
text: 'Mad' Pat Carrik inflicts an additional wound with melee strikes.

printInfos.flavorText: "What he lacks in wits, he makes up for with enthusiasm." - Doo'run

name: Makusog Steelhorn
text:
Adjacent Siege characters gain +2 to strike rolls
Limited Order: Your target Siege moves forward one rank.

printInfos.flavorText: When the Siegemasters build something too heavy for giants, the Legions turn to the makusog.

name: Mo'can
text:
Spend Order: Perform two +4 ranged strikes.
Limited React: After an opposing character moves without spending or stunning: Move forward one rank or perform a +7 ranged strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "Show me the way Mo'can. These Deverenians have lived too long on nothrog land." - Vactus

name: Muddflek
text: Order: Perform a +8 ranged strike. Kill Muddflek.

printInfos.flavorText: "Now there's a creature with flair!" - Sklot the Cruel

name: Nog, Pog, and Snivels
text:
Enter React: Perform a melee strike.
Death React: Perform a melee strike. Banish Nog, Pog, and Snivels.

printInfos.flavorText: "The foodstores are completely destroyed, and you don't want to hear about the latrines."  -Efrim

name: Novice Pyro
text: Spend Order: Perform a +2 ranged strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "Heh. Fire."

name: Rrok
text:
Wounds inflicted by Rrok's melee strikes may not be reduced.
Limited Order: Move forward one rank.

printInfos.flavorText: "It's been too long. The Legions must have a real war."

name: The Mighty Mugg
text: Limited Order: Target your adjacent equal or lower level character: Move the target forward up to two ranks. The target suffers a wound, then may perform a melee strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "Mugg make anything fly!"

name: Coward
text:
Your deck may include any number of cards named Coward.
Coward is the same factions as your Warlords.

printInfos.flavorText: "Go ahead, I'm... uh... right behind you."

name: Freelance Cavalier
text: Freelance Cavalier is the same alignments, factions, and classes as your Warlords.

printInfos.flavorText: "My horse needs paid, too."

name: Misearean Scout
text:
Misearean Scout is the same alignment, faction(s), and class(es) as your Warlord(s).
Spend Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike.

printInfos.flavorText: "I found something interesting over the next ridge, but it'll cost you..."

name: Nisha
text:
Before the game begins, choose a faction. Nisha is that faction.
After starting armies are revealed, choose up to two classes. Nisha permanently gains those classes.

printInfos.flavorText: "Could be my friends and I could help you--what's in it for us?"

name: Sarakian Sellsword
text: Sarakian Sellsword is the same alignment, factions, and classes as your Warlords.

printInfos.flavorText: "Gold buys my service, but not my respect."

name: Close Wounds
text: Spend Order: Target your character within one rank: Heal the target. The target gains +1 HP this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "Heal them once, and they won't mind getting hit the next time." - Azh'kal

name: Courage from Faith
text: Order: Unstun target character.

printInfos.flavorText: "There is always hope!" - Anacaona

name: Divine Barrier
text: React: After target character targets this character with a melee strike: Perform a melee strike against the target.

printInfos.flavorText: "Steel, Discipline, Faith-each will protect you. Embrace them." - Anvil

name: Divine Respite
text:
Roll Order: Target your other character,
1-9: Unstun the target.
10-19: Ready the target.
20: Ready the target. It gains +4 ATK and AC this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "Ease your mind! Give your troubles over to the Storm." - Hellene

name: Fateshift
text: Spend React: Before target character suffers wounds, reveal the top card of your deck: Reduce the wounds by one. The target gains a bonus to AC this turn equal to the level of the card revealed this way this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "Nothing is predetermined. We control our own destinies." - Anacaona

name: Final Blessing
text:
React: After target character pays the costs of an action to retrieve cards from a discard pile: Cancel the action. The target suffers a wound. 
React: Before target character suffers wounds: The target gains +1 HP this turn.
errata:
Rulings:
-Static effects like Fevered Shade are not actions and will not trigger Final Blessing.

printInfos.flavorText: "We commend thee to the sky, to the wind, to the Storm. Give up thy soul and welcome Eternity."

name: Gift From Above
text: Order: Target character gains a bonus to ATK and AC equal to this character's level this turn.

printInfos.flavorText: "You may swing the sword, but Neus will decide your fate." - Adathan

name: Invoke the Storm
text:
Spend Order: Put a Stormlord character token into play ready in your first rank. It's a level 5  evil Deverenian Empire Stormwraith fighter  with
+7/+7 lightning ATK, 8 AC, +7 skill, 3 HP, Planar, and "At end of turn, kill one of your Deverenian Empire characters."

printInfos.flavorText: "Behold its power!" - Hellene

name: Kor's Patience
text: Order: Perform a +5 ranged strike that stuns instead of wounds.
errata:
Rulings:
-Does not have to target an unstunned character.

printInfos.flavorText: "Best not try it further." - Memoriam

name: Nature's Ally
text: Spend Order: Put an Animal token into play within one rank. If this character is a Druid, Survey.

printInfos.flavorText: "Always follow the Water, Naulisa. Find your strength there, and you allies." - Anacaona

name: Pious Rebuke
